text: This report provides the Board of Health with an update on the risk management reporting that is part of the Ontario Public Health Standards Accountability Framework. It outlines risks and challenges facing Toronto Public Health in 2025, which include talent availability, resource capacity to address evolving and emerging public health issues, challenges in public confidence in public health advice, and changes to the Ontario Public Health Standards.
The Board of Health: 1. Received the report (April 17, 2025) from Acting Medical Officer of Health for information.
